transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Um, yeah, nice to meet you. I guess... I just get pulled off track really easily. By just, you know, every little sound or thought. Like if I'm trying to work on an application... a car outside, or my phone, or just some random idea sends me somewhere else. I don't even notice it happening. So... yeah. That's mainly it.
Do you have times when you feel unusually energized or keyed up compared with your normal self?
Um... no, not really. I don't think so. I just... I feel pretty much the same most of the time. Just regular, I guess.
When you were a child, did you also have a hard time staying focused?

Um... yeah, I guess. Even back in elementary school... they were always moving my seat. Just... I'd talk out of turn, or I'd forget my homework. And I guess I'd just rush through worksheets and make a bunch of careless mistakes. So... yeah.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?
Um... no. Not really. I mean... I guess I feel normal. Just... frustrated sometimes, maybe. But not depressed.
Do you often feel worried or anxious, even when there isn’t an obvious reason?
Um... no, not really. I mean, I don't think I worry more than anyone else. Just... normal stuff, I guess. Nothing major.
